question: On which of the following days Nagaland Statehood Day is observed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 December**__,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagaland** was formally recognised as **separate state on 1 December, 1963**.
 
• The **State of Nagaland Act ,1962 **was passed by the Parliament.
 
• After** Independence in 1947**, Naga territory initially remained **as a part of Assam but later a strong Nationalist union began seeking a political union of the Naga tribes.**
 
• In**1957 the Naga Hill regon of Assam and Tuensang Frontier Division of the Northeast **were bought together **under a single unit**.
 
• In** 1960 it was resolved** that **Nagaland** should become a **separate state**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capital - Kohima.**
 
• **Celebrated 59th statehood Day in 2021. **
 
• **Largest tribe- Konyak.**
 
• **Major festival - Hornbill Festival.**
